Creator: القمص منسى (as the host record gives the name; the OCR of the title page does not carry it)
Publisher: Cairo: مطبعة اليقظة (as the host record gives it; garbled in the OCR at lines 108-111)
Publication Date: 1924 (title page, read on the page image: "الطبعة الأولى سنة ١٩٢٤ م"; the OCR at line 148 misreads the last digit)
Rights: Public Domain (pd-us-by-date: printed 1924; the title-page year, read on the page image ("الطبعة الأولى سنة ١٩٢٤ م"); the OCR misreads the last digit; the archive.org record carries no rights field)
Language: ara
Source: archive.org item AAlexandrina-149858, full text from the item's own djvu.txt. Fetched directly 2026-11-15 by the Library thread; the byte count of the downloaded file (1,957,818) equals the size archive.org lists for the djvu.txt.
Provenance note: The item's own djvu.txt follows this header. No Google or Internet Archive notice was found to remove; nothing was stripped, normalized or corrected; library stamps and slips in the scan are left as they are. Rights basis: pd-us-by-date: printed 1924; the title-page year, read on the page image ("الطبعة الأولى سنة ١٩٢٤ م"); the OCR misreads the last digit; the archive.org record carries no rights field. Line numbers in this header are this file's own line numbers.
Content note: A history of the Coptic Church in Arabic, arranged by centuries. Poor OCR: it serves for finding a place, not for quotation. A preface "الى القارىء القبطي" at lines 296-311, unsigned and undated. Cyril IV is named at lines 22068 and 24329; Cyril V from line 22417 to line 24335; the lay council at lines 22854-23121. The Sunday schools were looked for and not found. The body ends at about line 24420; a list of subscribers follows.
